extracted.name: A-Maize-ing Corn Chowder
extracted.description: This easy soup recipe delivers a creamy corn chowder with canned corn, potatoes, and crumbled bacon for a comforting bowl of warm deliciousness.
instruction_lines: Fry bacon in a Dutch oven until crisp; remove bacon, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Crumble bacon and set aside.
Sauté onion in reserved drippings until tender; add potatoes and water. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Stir in milk, corn, salt, and pepper to taste; continue to cook, stirring frequently, until heated through. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon to serve.
